name: connectpak-neo4j
description: Read-only Neo4j access for AI agents over MCP: list schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries.

interface.longDescription: Read-only Neo4j access for AI agents over MCP: list schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries. Set $CONNECTPAK_NEO4J_URI in your environment before starting Codex. Writes are rejected by a parser guard and by the engine's own read-only mode; every query has a timeout and a row cap.
defaultPrompt: What tables are in my Neo4j database?
